name: Smarck
description: Smarck was a planet in Outer Rim Territories, Cademimu sector, Smarck system.
lead_paragraphs: Smarck was a planet in Outer Rim Territories, Cademimu sector, Smarck system.
For several years, Macus Kayniph was in charge of Black Sun operations on Smarck. Black Sun kept a storehouse of Spaarti cloning cylinders on the planet.
